title: Duke asks him to come back
summary: Duke called twice asking him to return, saying he only had to sit there; Cootie went back for him alone.

story.theme_name: Duke Ellington and his orchestra, as others knew them
story.community_name: Duke Ellington: the band, the man, his men

blocks.x: But during the period of time they were over there, Duke called me. He says, -- called me twice, I think. He says, "Are you ready to come back to go to work?" I said, "No, man. I ain't thinking about working no more." He said, "Ah, don't do that, man." He said, "I miss you so much." He said, "Come on back. You don't have to blow. Just sit up there and hold on."
I said, "Okay. I'll do it for you. Nobody else in the world I would do this for but you." And that's when I went back to work with him. The doctor had given me an okay, I could go back to work.
Yeah. Well, Cootie, yeah. I guess that was in '72, I guess, or like the end of '72.
Or -- but you didn't join them over there.
When they came back. Well, Cootie, what you're really saying is when he himself was sick.
No. He wasn't sick then. I don't think so.
Well, he came back in November.
You know. And he went into hospital in January. So maybe we're talking about the year before.
Maybe the year before, when I taken sick.

Yeah. But he probably came -- he probably went to Europe twice in there. Anyway, in other words, after you went back with him, you stayed in the band there while he was still alive, you stayed there about a year or more, didn't you?
Huh? Yeah. You stayed in the band. Yeah.
